label: EUTHYPHRO_HORN_2: consequence horns, independent standard or constituted by approval
definition: [EUTHYPHRO_HORN_2] In a DependenceFrame, horn 1 IndependentStandard says goodness is distinct from God and does not depend on him for what it is; horn 2 ConstitutedByApproval says goodness depends for what it is on God's approving or is that approving. HornsCover is their disjunction, NeitherHorn the negation of both.
note: Analyst formulation of the upshot the dilemma alleges for each literal horn (an external standard, or arbitrary constitution by command); attribution deferred.
